تحتملوا (form VIII)
# تَحْتَمِلُوا (taḥtamilū) /taħ.ta.mi.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَمَلَ (iḥtamala)
# تُحْتَمَلُوا (tuḥtamalū) /tuħ.ta.ma.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَمَلَ (iḥtamala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
